snippet.title: Soulmask 1.0 OUT NOW! Egypt DLC Free to Claim for the First Month
snippet.description:
A huge thank you to over 750,000 Chieftains who have supported us since Early Access! Soulmask 1.0 and the Egypt DLC Shifting Sands will launch together on April 10, 2026!
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460
Soulmask 1.0 introduces three new modes—Survival, Tribe, and Warrior—along with major new features and upgrades including the Tribesmen Position System, Unlimited Build Mode, Tribe Upgrade System, and Custom Boss Challenges.
The Egypt-themed DLC Soulmask: Shifting Sands also launches the same day. It features a world as large as the base game, with 500+ hours of content. Even if you’re new to Soulmask, you can begin your journey directly in Shifting Sands.
In Soulmask: Shifting Sands, you will survival in a unique world where ancient Egyptian myths meet alien technology. Collect the masks of the Egyptian gods to gain godlike powers, build your own airship mobile base, and uncover the forgotten dynasty’s truth behind gods, death, and immortality.
Special thanks to @DSLokutus — the Shark-Class and Falcon-Class airships featured in the video were both created by him.
